title: No-Charge Replacement Allowances in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
The allowances for no-charge replacement are the same on all six resupply schedules of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program (Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO and the Self-Pay Supply Subscription).

| Allowance | Value on every schedule |
|---|---|
| No-charge mask-fit exchanges allowed per new interface shipped | 1 |
| Calendar days after a new interface ships within which one no-charge fit exchange is allowed | 30 |
| Calendar days after a line ships within which a defective item is replaced at no charge | 30 |
| A no-charge replacement counts toward the item's schedule limit | no |
| Business days without delivery confirmation after which a lost shipment is reshipped at no charge | 7 |

## Terms explained

- **Fit exchange.** One no-charge exchange is allowed for each new interface shipped, within 30 calendar days of that interface's ship date.
- **Defect.** A defective item is replaced at no charge within 30 calendar days of the ship date of its line.
- **Lost shipment.** A shipment with no delivery confirmation after 7 business days is reshipped at no charge. The count is in business days, unlike the two 30-day allowances, which are calendar days.
- **Limits.** On no schedule does a no-charge replacement count toward the item's schedule limit.
